title: Raluca - Third Meeting

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Wow back again. I seem to have a real fan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow back again. I seem to have a real fan.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Well look, I'm a modern girl with modern tastes but maybe we could make this unofficially official?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well look, I'm a modern girl with modern tastes but maybe we could make this unofficially official?

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Well neither of us are getting any younger. Not down here anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well neither of us are getting any younger. Not down here anyway.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Well we have a few options. Would you like something exclusive or maybe keep things loose?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well we have a few options. Would you like something exclusive or maybe keep things loose?

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I was hoping you'd say that!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was hoping you'd say that!

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Yeah cool, no me either. Let's keep things fluid for now!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah cool, no me either. Let's keep things fluid for now!

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Sure, I mean there's no rush, I guess...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, I mean there's no rush, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I'm glad we didn't beat around the bush. Neither of us are getting any younger. Not down here at least.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm glad we didn't beat around the bush. Neither of us are getting any younger. Not down here at least.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Oh just another thing that is popular in the Spire. Anything life-prolonging is big business up there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh just another thing that is popular in the Spire. Anything life-prolonging is big business up there.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Not quite yet, but they'd like it to be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not quite yet, but they'd like it to be.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Some people think it is, although the idea that the richest people in society could possibly live even longer fills me with dread. Personally, I can't think of anything worse than immortality.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some people think it is, although the idea that the richest people in society could possibly live even longer fills me with dread. Personally, I can't think of anything worse than immortality.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Someone once said, "The idea is to die young as late as possible". I live by that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone once said, "The idea is to die young as late as possible". I live by that.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Oh, it is. Believe me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, it is. Believe me!

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Among the stinking rich, some envy their heirs so much that they want to prevent them from inheriting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Among the stinking rich, some envy their heirs so much that they want to prevent them from inheriting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm still trying to work that out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm still trying to work that out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm still trying to work that out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm still trying to work that out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sure do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sure do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How so?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How so?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's go exclusive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's go exclusive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure I'm ready for a big commitment yet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure I'm ready for a big commitment yet.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure I'm ready for a big commitment yet.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure I'm ready for a big commitment yet.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hate labels.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hate labels.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Great!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Immortality?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Immortality?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that even possible?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that even possible?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I agree.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I agree.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd love to live forever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd love to live forever.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's not much different down here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not much different down here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's not much different down here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's not much different down here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not even sure I want to live forever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not even sure I want to live forever.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not even sure I want to live forever.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not even sure I want to live forever.
